div.aria-label: Pipeline diagram; use the arrow keys to scroll it sideways

svg.title: How the cybersecurity data is built
svg.desc: Left to right. Published by others: FRED exchange rates, Evaluation plan, Yahoo Finance, East Money forecast, East Money valuation, East Money reports, CIBR holdings, Public statements. Raw read: FX rates, Pool, Yahoo responses, East Money rows, East Money tables, CIBR file, Curated files. Weekly tables: Consensus table, Valuation history, Validated rows. Metrics: metrics.py, China panel, etf.py. Regression, scoreboard: regression.py, evaluate.py, ledger.py. Marts (data/marts/cyber): regression, listings, scoreboard, china_panel, etf_crosscheck, private_intervals. Gate, facts, page: pandera gate, regression guard, facts/cyber.json, this page. Dashed boxes are read in memory and their raw payload is not kept, only the parsed fields. A bar on the left edge marks a curated file: every row has a source link, a date and a qualifier.
svg.text: read in memory; the raw payload is not kept, only the parsed fields
curated, with a source link, date and qualifier for every row

ol.aria-label: How the cybersecurity data is built, as a list

ul.li: FRED exchange rates: dollars per currency, newest rate on file.
Evaluation plan: section I, registered definitions and pool.
Yahoo Finance: price, EV, targets, ratings, revenue est.
East Money forecast: A-share consensus, six-month ratings.
East Money valuation: daily PS_TTM and PB.
East Money reports: A-share revenue, by report date.
CIBR holdings: First Trust ETF page.
Public statements: filings, releases, priced rounds, deals.
FX rates: read at publish; newest per currency. From FRED exchange rates.
Pool: pool.py, as registered layer, ring, purity. From Evaluation plan.
Yahoo responses: read in memory; parsed fields kept. From Yahoo Finance.
East Money rows: read in memory; parsed fields kept. From East Money forecast.
East Money tables: read in memory; parsed fields kept. From East Money valuation, East Money reports.
CIBR file: cibr_holdings_*.json, tickers and names. From CIBR holdings.
Curated files: private_*.json, events, link, date, qualifier. Curated: a source link, a date and a qualifier on every row. From Public statements.
Consensus table: consensus/*.parquet; last good run, Mondays. From Yahoo responses, East Money rows.
Valuation history: valuation_history_em/ daily PS_TTM, revenue. From East Money tables.
Validated rows: reference.rows(): checked, notes stripped. Curated: a source link, a date and a qualifier on every row. From Curated files.
metrics.py: EV/NTM, growth, FCF, Rule of 40, upside. From Consensus table, Pool, FX rates.
China panel: PS_TTM percentile, revenue growth y/y. From Valuation history.
etf.py: CIBR against the pool; a gap fails the check. From CIBR file.
regression.py: EV/NTM on growth, layers, residuals. From metrics.py.
evaluate.py: Q1-Q10 as registered; collecting until graded. From metrics.py, regression.py, ledger.py.
ledger.py: private intervals, events, unconfirmed. From metrics.py, Validated rows.
regression: latest, series, residuals, premium. From regression.py.
listings: + layer_summary, targets, recommendations. From metrics.py.
scoreboard: + evidence, kpis. From evaluate.py.
china_panel: A-share listings. From China panel.
etf_crosscheck: + excluded, metric_dictionary. From etf.py.
private_intervals: + ledger_*, events, reported_unconfirmed. From ledger.py.
pandera gate: a schema failure blocks the write. From regression, listings, scoreboard, china_panel, etf_crosscheck, private_intervals.
regression guard: a thin run keeps the last good facts. From pandera gate.
facts/cyber.json: every number the page prints. From regression guard.
this page: prose templated; charts read the marts. From facts/cyber.json.
